content: Google recommends verifying Google ID tokens server-side using the official google-auth-library (npm install google-auth-library), calling client.verifyIdToken({ idToken, audience: WEB_CLIENT_ID }). Only trust the token's 'sub' claim as the stable unique user identifier (not email, which can change). For the OAuth authorization code flow, Google POSTs credential to a redirect endpoint -- verify CSRF via double-submit-cookie pattern before consuming it.
